summary: Frontend-only mobile retest on the public Expo preview. Dashboard and bottom navigation loaded, an expense saved and persisted into History, Clear dates reset both range fields, and Export CSV invoked without a visible runtime error. Native date picker opened through the trigger but exposes no selectable web control in the preview, so actual date selection and date-range constraint could not be verified here.
action_items: Verify native date selection and from/to filtering on iOS or Android Expo runtime; web preview cannot expose the native picker selection UI.
critical_code_review_comments: Local storage is awaited for persistence and no API is used. Export builds the requested Date, Category, Amount, Notes columns. Expo logs only non-blocking package compatibility warnings.

success_rate.frontend: 80% of executable checks passed; native date selection/range constraint blocked by web preview limitation

seed_data_creation: Created one local $12.50 Food expense during testing; not deleted after this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fresh mobile viewport 375x667 against https://expense-tracker-6729.preview.emergentagent.com. Web DateTimePicker rendered no input[type=date] or selectable dialog. Clear dates and export control worked; local storage contains one $12.50 Food item.
rca_of_issue: The date trigger renders @react-native-community/datetimepicker, but Expo web preview does not expose native picker controls, preventing automated selection. This is an environment limitation rather than a confirmed app defect; verify on a native device before release sign-off. No mocked APIs were used.
